description_en: Queries the details of a single 5G message asset
description_zh: 单个查询5G消息素材详情
name: QueryRCSAssetDetail

parameters.help_en: The signature name. This parameter is required and can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。非空，最长128字符
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The asset code. This parameter is required and can be up to 64 characters in length. This code is returned when you create an asset by calling the CreateRCSAsset operation
parameters.help_zh: 素材编码。非空，最长64字符。通过CreateRCSAsset接口创建素材时返回
parameters.name: asset_code

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed information returned when access is denied
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝时返回的详细信息

Code.description_en: The request status code. OK indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

AssetFileSize.description_en: The asset file size, in kB

AssetFileType.description_en:
The asset file type. Valid values:

1: Image.
2: Audio.
3: Video
AssetFileType.description_zh:
素材文件类型。取值：

1：图片。
2：音频。
3：视频

AssetFileUrl.description_en: The downloadable OSS URL of the asset file, which includes a signature and an expiration time
AssetFileUrl.description_zh: 素材文件可下载的OSS URL，带签名和有效期

AuditStatusList.description_en: The audit status list aggregated by carrier and product type
AuditStatusList.description_zh: 按运营商和产品类型聚合的审核状态列表

AuditFailInfo.description_en: The audit failure information. This parameter has a value only when auditStatus is 2
AuditFailInfo.description_zh: 审核异常信息，仅auditStatus为2时有值

AssetFileAuditFailReason.description_en: The audit failure reason for the asset file
AssetFileAuditFailReason.description_zh: 素材文件审核异常信息

ThumbnailFileAuditFailReason.description_en: The audit failure reason for the thumbnail file
ThumbnailFileAuditFailReason.description_zh: 缩略图文件审核异常信息

AuditStatus.description_en:
The aggregated audit status. Valid values:

0: Under review.
1: Approved.
2: Rejected
AuditStatus.description_zh:
聚合审核状态。取值：

0：审核中。
1：审核通过。
2：审核失败

BizProductType.description_en:
The product type. Valid values:

10: 5G notification.
11: 5G marketing
BizProductType.description_zh:
产品类型。取值：

10：5G通知。
11：5G营销

Carrier.description_en:
The carrier. Valid values:

1: China Mobile.
2: China Unicom.
3: China Telecom
Carrier.description_zh:
运营商。取值：

1：移动。
2：联通。
3：电信

ExpireStatus.description_en:
The expiration status. Valid values:

0: Not expired.
1: Expired
ExpireStatus.description_zh:
过期状态。取值：

0：未过期。
1：已过期

ThumbnailFileUrl.description_en: The downloadable OSS URL of the thumbnail file, which includes a signature and an expiration time
ThumbnailFileUrl.description_zh: 缩略图文件可下载的OSS URL，带签名和有效期

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
